summary: Backend-only verification of the T+30m pickup bump reminder + the extraction of 4 shipping routes into routers/shipping.py. Ran full requested pytest slice (57 tests) — all pass. Verified all 4 shipping endpoints are registered in the FastAPI schema (via /openapi.json) and return HTTP 401 unauthenticated through the public preview URL. Inspected pickup_reminder_loop Mongo filter and _send_pickup_email reminder_30m branch — both match spec.

verifications.pickup_reminder_loop_filter: Confirmed at server.py L6362-6408 — filter uses fulfillment_status=pending_pickup + created_at in [now-60m, now-30m] + pickup_bump_30m_sent_at $exists:false. verifications.send_pickup_email_reminder_30m: server.py L6306-6308 renders headline 'You have a new order waiting' + urgency 'You haven't opened the pickup yet — accept now to lock in your profit.' as specified.
verifications.shipping_router_extraction: routers/shipping.py exists (~330 lines), imported at server.py L50 and mounted at L7332 with prefix=/api. All 4 target paths present in /openapi.json: POST /api/orders/{order_id}/shipping-label, GET /api/orders/{order_id}/label.svg, GET /api/orders/{order_id}/tracking, POST /api/orders/{order_id}/shipping-advance.
verifications.auth_enforcement: All 4 shipping endpoints return HTTP 401 to unauthenticated curl against the public preview URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). label.svg supports the ?auth= query fallback per source.
verifications.server_py_size: server.py = 7581 lines (was ~7822 before split), consistent with the described trim.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 7581 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Continued modular splits (pickup loops, wallet/orders background workers) recommended in future iterations.
